title: Apply validated Sony ARW lens correction tables component by component
source: RapidRoom Rust reimplementation of darktable Sony metadata formulae (GPL-3.0-or-later attribution)
notes: Explicit Auto camera recipe version 1 prefers valid Sony ARW distortion tables, with Lensfun fallback and renderer-owned per-component source and payload identity. Existing saved recipes retain legacy behavior. Camera vignetting and TCA remain disabled pending independent same-shot residual validation; mathematical support alone is not a shipping claim.
